title: Figure 5: Fatigue limit of metallic glasses and metallic-glass-matrix composites
description: Log-log plot of stress amplitude/ultimate tensile strength versus number of cycles to failure (10^3 to 10^8). Data series compare a "Single-phase metallic glass" (red circles), a "Dendritic composite" (blue squares) and "High-strength steel" (dashed line), with arrows marking run-outs. Caption: "Figure 5. Fatigue Limit of Metallic Glasses and Metallic-Glass-Matrix Composites", noting zirconium-based glass data and 300-M steel for comparison.
